title: Green Run 2 Test - Complete Broadcast
description: Engineers powered up all of the Artemis I core stage systems, load more than 700,000 gallons of supercold propellant into the tanks, and fire the rocket’s four RS-25 engines at the same time to simulate the stage’s operation during the launch of our first Artemis mission to the Moon.
keywords: RS-25, Artemis, Hot Fire Test, Green Run, SLS, Stennis Space Center, Core Stage
via: the NASA Image and Video Library
